name: Live space weather: CMEs modelled to Mars, particle events, solar flares
mission: NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center (CCMC) and Moon to Mars Space Weather Analysis Office
product: DONKI: WSA-ENLIL simulations (impactList), SEP and FLR event lists
notes: Asked live, at most every 30 minutes, through api/spaceweather.ts (api.nasa.gov, with ccmc.gsfc.nasa.gov as the fallback for each feed) or by the browser from ccmc.gsfc.nasa.gov directly. Not bundled. Arrival times at Mars come from the WSA-ENLIL model and are good to about half a day. A slice retrieved on 2026-11-14 is kept in tests/fixtures/donki-2026-11.json for the unit tests.
